_comment: Plastic and microplastics first. tier 1 is the core beat. Roughly two thirds of tier 1 is now product-intent (is X safe, what did you switch to) rather than mechanism, matching what people actually search. tier 2 is adjacent chemistry and the heavy-metal product beat, which performs well on site but is not strictly plastic.
_excludeNote: Accounts whose framing does not fit an education-and-research brand. Editorial call, not a fact. Edit freely.
